---

## 1. 本季度收入同比增长百分比

**出处**：`financial_statements.txt` 位置 8877-8878（Intelligent Cloud 利润表）

**原始数据**：
- **FY26 Q4（截至 2026年6月30日）**：Intelligent Cloud 收入 = **$39,306 百万**
- **FY25 Q4（截至 2025年6月30日）**：Intelligent Cloud 收入 = **$29,878 百万**

**计算过程**：

```
同比增长率 = (39,306 - 29,878) / 29,878 × 100
           = 9,428 / 29,878 × 100
           = 31.56%
```

管理层在新闻稿中将此表述为 **32%**（四舍五入），按固定汇率口径为 **31%**。来源：`press_release.txt` 位置 3115："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"。

---

## 2. 管理层在电话会上的归因（原文引用）

**出处**：`transcript.txt` 位置 24908–25530（电话会 "Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment" 段落）

管理层将 Intelligent Cloud 增长归因于以下几个因素：

| 归因因素 | 原话引用 |
|---|---|
| ① Azure 43% 增长（基数含加速增长） | "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth." |
| ② 需求超过供应 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity." |
| ③ CPU/GPU 效率提升和流程改进 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity." |
| ④ 额外产能被变现 | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized." |
| ⑤ GitHub Copilot 消费超预期 | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value." |
| ⑥ 本地服务器业务持平 | "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency." |

---

## 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述 的区分

### ✅ 已发生的事实（过去已实现）

| 条目 | 原文引用 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|
| Azure 收入增长 43% | "revenue grew 43%" | 过去式，报告 Q4 实际结果（`press_release.txt` 位置 3115："Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%"） |
| 需求超过可用容量（当前持续状态） | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | 现在进行时，描述已观察到的 Q4 现状 |
| 收入增长超预期 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations" | "was" → 过去事实 |
| CPU/GPU 机群效率提升 | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | 完成态 gains，表示已实现 |
| 流程改进使新产能提前交付 | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | 已完成 |
| 本季度额外 Azure 产能被快速变现 | "was quickly monetized" | 过去被动语态 |
| GitHub Copilot 消费超预期 | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | 6月变更后已在 Q4 产生结果 |
| 本地服务器收入同比持平 | "revenue was relatively unchanged" | 过去事实 |

**依据**：使用过去时态（was, grew, were, had）或完成态名词（gains, improvements），描述 Q4 期间已发生的、可验证的结果。

### 🔮 前瞻性表述（面向未来）

| 条目 | 原文引用 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|
| "remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps" | transcript 位置 ~25900："we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | "remain focused" 是持续性的未来承诺；"bridge the gaps" 暗示未来行动 |
| "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | transcript 位置 ~32535："we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | "expect" + "continue to" 明确的未来指引 |
| Q1 FY27 收入指引 | press_release 位置 32535："For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%" | "we expect" + 具体数字，明确的未来预测 |
| Azure Q1 增速指引 | press_release 位置 32535："In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" | "we expect"，未来指引 |
| "customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | transcript 位置 24908 | "continues" 不仅是描述现状，更暗示这一态势将延续至未来（用于为未来增长做铺垫） |

**依据**：使用 "expect"、"remain focused on"、"continue to expect" 等未来导向动词，或将当前持续状态（"continues"）用于为后续业绩做解释/铺垫。

### ⚠️ 模糊地带

"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" 是一处灰色地带——"continues" 既描述了 Q4 期间已观察到的持续状态（事实），也被管理层用作解释未来增长潜力的理由（前瞻性）。我将其归为**已发生事实**，因为其语法核心是描述当前/过去的状态，但其**语境功能**确实服务于对未来增长的解释。
